original_test_intent: Measure PCIe eye margin on every in-scope lane of the designated ConnectX or BlueField endpoint with NVQual Test #22 and demonstrate that the raw horizontal and vertical margins meet the approved link-generation limits without downtraining, new errors, traffic impact, hang or reboot.
original_method: Pin the NIC or DPU serial, physical port and BDF plus root-port, switch, retimer and lane mapping; record negotiated generation/width and equalization context; obtain the exact Test #22 scan axes, units, sampling and per-lane thresholds; drain traffic and preserve pre-state; collect every raw lane result with synchronized link/AER/NIC/platform telemetry; stop on the first missing or out-of-limit lane or link disturbance and use the approved vendor recovery path.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE provides the licensed Test #22 method, physical lane map and generation-specific limits; an operator drains dependent traffic, approves any retrain impact and owns recovery.
required_inputs: Licensed pinned NVQual Test #22 eye-margin module and compatible ConnectX/BlueField firmware and driver
NIC/DPU serial, port and BDF with root-port/switch/retimer/per-lane topology
Negotiated generation/width, equalization or preset context, scan axes/units/sampling and per-lane limits
Traffic drain, allowed retrain behavior, error and platform aborts, and vendor recovery
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated drained SUT and obtain explicit approval for any link retrain or traffic interruption
Preserve the original logs, AER counters and negotiated-link baseline
Do not alter equalization policy, reset the NIC or force retraining outside the pinned procedure
Stop on link loss/downtraining, unexpected retrain, AER burst, NIC disappearance, traffic impact, thermal/power issue, hang, reboot or incomplete lane output
agent_execution_scope: Verify the physical target and complete lane path, scan method, baseline, limits and interlocks
Run only the approved Test #22 module with its pinned generation and equalization context
Retain all per-lane raw eye measurements and correlate them with link, AER, NIC and platform state
Do not infer lane limits, retrain/reset after a fault, repeat an incomplete scan automatically or issue a DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #22 version and scan semantics, exact ConnectX/BlueField path, lane matrix and limits
Define allowed link impact, error acceptance, aborts and recovery
Review the complete lane evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It selects the relevant vendor test family, but without the exact sub-test, target and lane/generation thresholds it is not reproducible; a top-level pass cannot prove every required lane was scanned.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the pinned NVQual Test #22 eye scan only on the approved stable-identity NIC/DPU path and preserve complete per-lane raw margins, method metadata, thresholds and correlated link/error state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #22, ConnectX PCIe eye margin, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/15-minute allocation remain; absent scan parameters and limits are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH CONNECTX BLUEFIELD PER-LANE PCIE EYE QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Evaluate each raw horizontal and vertical margin in the vendor-defined units against its approved limit while binding the result to physical endpoint, lane, link generation, width and equalization context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable physical path identity, explicit measurement semantics and per-lane limits, raw artifacts, traffic isolation, link-health correlation and controlled recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An aggregate module result can conceal an untested or marginal lane, wrong port, lower-than-required generation, changed equalization context or a recovered retrain.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor margin scans are link- and tool-version-specific and can retrain or disturb a live NIC path; dependent traffic and first-fault evidence must be protected.

project_override_considerations: An equivalent vendor margin facility is acceptable only when its physical-lane mapping, units, sampling and limits are approved and it retains complete raw results. Link-up, BER or throughput evidence alone does not replace eye-margin coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #22 module/license/configuration and authorization
NIC/DPU serial, port, BDF and root-port/switch/retimer/per-lane path with generation/width/equalization state
Approved scan axes, units, sampling and per-lane threshold matrix
Complete untruncated raw horizontal/vertical margin measurements and threshold comparison for every lane
Pre/during/post negotiated-link, AER, NIC, driver, dmesg/journal, BMC/SEL, traffic, thermal and power evidence
Abort/recovery or clean final link/traffic state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #22 Procedure, Criteria and same-row reviews consistently target ConnectX/BlueField PCIe eye margin. Missing scan details and limits are supplyable prerequisites, not conflicting source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The lane-margin purpose is clear. Licensed tooling, physical mapping, scan semantics and limits can be supplied, so they do not make the static review irreducibly blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2141 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00018-V002: approve the pinned NVQual Test #22 eye-margin module, ConnectX/BlueField serial/port/BDF and root-port/switch/retimer/per-lane map, generation/width/equalization context, scan axes/units/sampling and per-lane limits, permitted retrain/traffic impact, aborts, and vendor recovery.

review_improvement: Replaces a top-level tool pass with complete physical-lane-bound measurements and makes link disturbance, traffic isolation and recovery explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Eye margin is not a device-wide Boolean property: each lane can have different analog headroom, and the measured value depends on link generation, equalization state and the vendor scan definition. Consequently, acceptance must use raw per-lane values and a fixed physical path. Any retrain can change equalization and invalidate comparability, so the first disturbance ends the run rather than triggering a retry.
